## Summary

Checked whether a foglamp publish can be undone before agreeing to it. No documented DELETE endpoint and no lifecycle docs; scans carry expiresAt and the editToken permits update only, so blanking via update is the sole retraction. Recorded the trap: the token must be gitignored from the public repo yet also copied somewhere durable, or the page becomes untouchable until it expires. Also recorded why publishing is safe here specifically (repo already public) and why that reasoning must not transfer to sofar-cloud.
